description.text: At night, a rectangular bus window fills the view, its cool glass clouded at the edges and beaded with rain. Drops cling in irregular clusters, each catching a small point of reflected city light. One by one, the beads break into thin, wavering lines that run downward, merging and dividing as they travel. Beyond the window, out-of-focus blocks of building shadow and warm amber streetlight drift horizontally past, stretching into soft smears behind the rain. The bus interior stays dark and quiet, with only a faint sheen along the window frame. The motion is continuous and uneven: fresh drops gather, older trails waver, and the city outside slides steadily across the glass.
Rain beads across the dark bus window while blurred city lights glow beyond the glass.
Drops merge and run down in thin trails as the outside lights drift sideways.
A cluster of droplets gathers near the lower edge, trembles, and begins to slide.
The camera holds a static shot.

The view moves closer to the rain-streaked glass, where condensation softens every edge. A single heavy drop swells among finer beads, its curved surface trembling with reflected amber and white light. It hesitates, quivers, and then breaks free, cutting a crooked clear channel through the misted pane. The trail widens as the drop travels, exposing dark glass and bright wet edges. Around it, smaller droplets hang in place, while the blurred city outside glides past in a slow smear of gold and pale white. The cleared path catches the night glow, drawing a slick bright line down the window as the surrounding condensation dissolves into a hazy veil. Near the lower edge, the drop slows and gathers a tiny pooled bead before the next streak overtakes it.
The close view reveals condensation misting the glass and a single large drop among smaller beads.
The heavy drop breaks free and cuts a crooked clear channel through the condensation.
The cleared trail widens and catches amber and white reflections as smaller drops hang nearby.
A pale smear of passing city light glides across the wet glass and fades.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
